reviews.text: Had backyard patio screens installed. Phenomenal quality product and professional team. We are now able to enjoy our backyard year round with sun and pest protection. The patio screens even keep my interior home cooler. Thank you Citadel Screens team. You are five star.
reviews.author: Teresa smith

reviews.text: We love our screens! Thank you so much. It is so nice to enjoy our space bug free!! Definitely want them on the back patio too once we finish planning! I would post pics but it wont let me.
reviews.author: Kim Rickard

reviews.text: These guys are awesome.  Their patio screens are amazing.  Really great product.  The installation team is tremendous; super courteous, knowledgeable and professional.  Thank you for your great work!
reviews.author: Patrick Spaulding

reviews.text: Can’t say enough great things about this company! They are experts at what they do and worth every penny. Our space is completely transformed because of them and turned out better than we ever imagined!
reviews.author: Kenzie Mcilvoy

reviews.text: Hard to put into words how grateful I am for this company. Night and day difference. Exemplary level of professionalism. 10/10 customer service. Will be utilizing their services for future projects.
reviews.author: NoSurprise44

reviews.text: The crew was professional and I’m very satisfied with my new screen. Pricing was fair and upfront. Game changer for Texas summers
reviews.author: Riley Burt

data.summary: Reviews are positive and contain authentic details, but the pattern of all reviews being exactly 'a year ago' and all being perfect 5-stars with no negative feedback is unusual. The low volume and clustered timing raise mild suspicion, but the content itself reads as genuine.
authentic_signals: Mention of specific benefits (sun/pest protection, cooler home)
Varied author names and writing styles
